screens.name: notification-overlay
screens.description: Notification overlay renders in a separate frameless BrowserWindow (src/notification-main.tsx) when a new prompt scan event fires. Cross-cut guard for §9.1.
screens.tbd: (1) The notification window may not be visible until at least one notification arrives; the seed currently does not synthesize an `onNewPromptScan` event. P0.5 leaves the eval step as a placeholder for U1-VR-side wiring (e.g., add a `__qaTriggerNotification` test hook in src/notification-main.tsx OR fire an IPC event from the main process). (2) Confirm the notification window's URL pattern via `agent-browser tab` at run-time.

screens.name: setup-guide
screens.description: SetupGuide stage of FirstRunOnboarding (post provider-pick 'wait for session' stage). FirstRunOnboarding.tsx:148-149.
screens.tbd: §7 P0.4 declares setup-guide profile as 'HOME with the first-run gate cleared but no provider configured', but the codebase only renders SetupGuide inside FirstRunOnboarding's wait-stage. Best-guess interpretation here is first-run profile + click-to-enter-wait-stage. Verify selector `.first-run-provider-card` matches the actual rendered ProviderPickerCards classnames at U1-VR run-time. Alternative: add a non-first-run rendering path for SetupGuide before U1-VR (out of P0.5 scope).
